svg.title: Confirmed 110 mm Scan Field and whole-substrate command-center map
svg.desc: An exact-scale global X field map for eight confirmed 110 millimeter scan fields, followed by a logical enlarged map of 15,750 unique command centers across 45 cells. All 16,742 raw records are inside the nominal GY range, and double rings mark 992 repeated lane-start records.
svg.text: Confirmed 110 mm Scan Field · 45 Cells / 8 Heads
Top band = exact Global X scale · lower map = enlarged cell detail · DOE 4×4 branches are not expanded
Exact-scale Global X allocation · nominal Local GY range −55 ≤ GY < +55 mm
Global Review X (mm) · field ownership uses [lower, upper)
126 unique X command columns · exact scale
X=330 boundary · H3 margin 0.5625 / H4 margin 0.3375 mm
Cell Align X increases · 100 mm pitch
Cell Align Y increases · 200 mm pitch

g.text: Double ring = identical position recorded twice
Only the top field band is metric. Lower cell grids are enlarged and not a physical glass boundary.
